description_en: Initiates a task to import data from a destination URL to a Microservices Engine (MSE) ZooKeeper instance
description_zh: 发起Zookeeper数据导入任务，使Zookeeper集群开始导入目标URL内的数据
kebab_example: aliyun mse import-zookeeper-data --instance-id mse_prepaid_public_cn-u0t2xzvxa06 --file-url http://xxxxxxxxxx --file-name snapshot.5 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --request-pars '{}' --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImportZookeeperData

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the source data.

You must set this parameter to the URL that is generated by calling the GetZookeeperDataImportUrl operation
parameters.help_zh:
源数据链接。
需要使用通过GetZookeeperDataImportUrl接口生成的URL
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.help_en: The name of the file that you want to import
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en: The extended request parameters in the JSON format
parameters.name: request_pars

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language
